- [ ] Academic source (Reference: _____________)
- [ ] Historical documentation (Reference: _____________)

### Confidence Level
<!-- How confident are you in the accuracy? -->
- [ ] Very High (Native speaker or verified by multiple sources)
- [ ] High (Academic source or verified by one native speaker)
- [ ] Medium (Community knowledge or single historical source)
- [ ] Low (Personal research, needs verification)
